verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a local API, CLI, MCP server and agent toolkit that developers could use to build extensions. However, the evidence never shows an in-app plugin catalog, marketplace, or one-click install of community extensions. Those APIs are developer building blocks rather than the browse-and-install capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse and install from a large catalog of community plugins/extensions to add features the core app doesn't ship
